title: PinPin steps down — character-only edit
beat: After supervised steering, PinPin descends to rejoin Mama and PomPom before everyone walks back to picnic.
camera: Same side as boarding, slightly wider to show Beaver on grass; hood left.
staging: Exactly four animals; PinPin on exterior steps, Beaver on grass assisting, Mama and baby waiting.
alt: PinPin steps down from the parked tractor with Beaver helping from the ground while Mama and PomPom wait.

references.role: Sole edit target; preserve tractor, steps, location and waiting family, change only Beaver and PinPin action.

prompt: Edit this image only by changing Beaver and PinPin into a getting-OFF-the-tractor action. Move Beaver from inside the doorway onto the grass beside it, blue vest, feet on ground, one helping paw extended, tail behind him. Turn PinPin outward and put him LOWER on the EXISTING steps, one hind paw planted on the bottom tread and the other hind paw on the next tread, descending toward Beaver. PinPin's one forepaw holds Beaver's helping paw, other forepaw touches existing step edge or fixed rail naturally. Preserve their faces, fur, quills and relative sizes. Empty the cab of animals. Leave Mama and tiny PomPom EXACTLY unchanged at right. Exactly four animals, normal attached limbs. Keep ALL tractor and background geometry unchanged: original step positions and spacing, original red door sill and floor height, original seat height, steering, wheels, empty trailer and yellow crane, bridge, forest, camera and lighting. The action is a simple final step DOWN toward ground; do not raise the floor or add stairs. Finished landscape1536x1024 children's storybook illustration, no text.
review: Superseded draft. Entry steps and threshold now much closer to boarding, and PinPin has a supported downward pose. However Beaver was incorrectly rendered with hedgehog-like quills and a furry tail, and an extra tall operator-like seat appeared ahead of original chair. These are clear failures, not acceptable caveats.
